definitions.explanation: Of a higher grade, rank, or level; advanced or superior in quality or education.

examples.japanese: {高等|こうとう}{学校|がっこう}を{卒業|そつぎょう}した。
examples.notes: 高等学校 = high school (formal term)

examples.japanese: {高等|こうとう}{教育|きょういく}を{受|う}ける{機会|きかい}が{増|ふ}えた。
examples.english: Opportunities to receive higher education have increased.

examples.japanese: これは{高等|こうとう}な{技術|ぎじゅつ}が{必要|ひつよう}な{仕事|しごと}だ。
examples.english: This is work that requires advanced skills.

notes:
COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{高等|こうとう}{学校|がっこう} (high school, often abbreviated to {高校|こうこう})
・{高等|こうとう}{教育|きょういく} (higher education)
・{高等|こうとう}{裁判所|さいばんしょ} (high court)
・{高等|こうとう}{動物|どうぶつ} (higher animals)

OPPOSITE:
・{初等|しょとう} (elementary, primary)
・{中等|ちゅうとう} (intermediate, secondary)

NOTE: In everyday speech, {高校|こうこう} is much more common than {高等|こうとう}{学校|がっこう}.

[Register: Formal]
